design: autopsy.processed follows _file_tokens (per-file dedupe) so it sums to the meter; processed_unique excludes message ids already counted in an older transcript (forks), reported as fork_calls/fork_tokens, never hidden. forecast row = units x calls_per_unit x (floor + context_image) x (1 + repair); any missing input -> tokens null, confidence unmeasured, missing named; a stated repair of 0 is a value; total is flagged lower_bound while any row is unmeasured. Confidence = weakest input basis (measured:* / estimated / unmeasured).
mutation_checks: absent forecast input treated as a value
